{{MultipleIssues|citation|moresources}}
[[File:Rex_pauldron.png|thumb|250px|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] sported an upswept pauldron during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]

'''Pauldrons''' were colored pieces of padded material worn by several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and later by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. The pauldron designated either a rank or an area of expertise. Occasionally, during times of internal struggle within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the colors and markings on pauldrons were used to signify allegiance to specific leaders or factions. For clones, while they were indeed used to show rank, pauldrons could also be customizations to their armor. Over the period of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the pauldron design changed frequently. Recruited ARC-troopers wore two, such as [[Fives/Legends|Fives]]. Some protruded more than others; shape and size also varied.
[[File:EchoFivesARCarmor-TC.png|thumb|Recruited ARC Troopers [[Fives/Legends|"Fives"]] and [[Echo/Legends|"Echo"]] sporting the double-sided pauldron]]

==Designations==
[[File:Stormtrooper_sergeants_pauldron.jpg|thumb|Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] Sergeant's pauldron]]
[[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|Sandtrooper]] pauldrons designated the following:
*'''Black''' - Enlisted ranks
*'''White''' - Sergeant
*'''Orange''' - Squad Leader

[[Field stormtrooper|Field Trooper]] pauldrons designated the following:
*'''Orange'''- [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11]] equipped Field Trooper
*'''Yellow''' - [[Rail detonator]] equipped Field Trooper
*'''Red''' - [[Imperial repeater rifle|Imperial Repeater Rifle]] equipped Field Trooper

[[Imperial Marines/Legends|Imperial Marines]] and [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock trooper]] pauldrons designated the following:
*'''Orange''' - The normal color worn by these units. Orange colored pauldron was also standard equipped on the stormtrooper [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]

Some regular [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] units from around 1.5 years [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] had pauldrons that designated the following:
*'''Gray''' - Bombardier
*'''Yellow''' - Rifleman
*'''Red''' - Medic
*'''Blue''' - Sniper
*'''Orange''' - Captain

Phase I [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] pauldrons designated the following:
*'''Green''' - Sergeant
*'''Blue''' - Lieutenant
*'''Red''' - Captain
*''' Yellow''' - Commander
Phase II Clone Trooper Pauldrons:

*'''Double-sided''' - ARC Trooper
*'''Single-sided''' - Clone captain or Commander
